thread:
release-lead: 🚨 Heads up — there's an eviction storm hitting mlserv workers in us-west1 causing intermittent p95 latency spikes. I have a hotfix that adjusts pod eviction grace and the internal backpressure window. Need expedited signoff to push mlserv@3.2.1-hotfix-evict into production in the late change window.
ops-bot: deploy-bot created deploy candidate: mlserv@3.2.1-hotfix-evict -> canary us-west1 (5% traffic) -> rollout plan: 5% -> 30% @ +10m -> 100% @ +25m. Pin requested for 2h post-rollout.
sre-eli: Need explicit rollback criteria. Propose: rollback if 5xx rate > 1% OR p95 latency increases > 250ms sustained for 3 minutes OR error budget burn > 5% over 10m. Agree?
oncall-maya: Agreed to those thresholds. I'll be watching and can pause immediately. :thumbsup:
mlinfra-jin: FYI this changes PDB and evictionGraceSeconds to 60s. Smoke test snippets below. I verified the image digest.
```
# check canary pod health
kubectl -n mlserv get pods -l app=mlserv-canary -o wide
# quick predict check
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://canary-us-west1.redwood-inference/v1/predict -d '{"input":"hello"}' | jq '.status'
```
qa-rob: I can run the smoke in staging in ~3m, but we're tight on the window. Will report results in ~5m.
release-lead: Approvals needed: @sre-eli @oncall-maya @mlinfra-jin @qa-rob. If you can +1 here we'll kick. Also requesting a temporary version pin so autoscaler or infra jobs don't nudge it.
sre-eli: +1, will watch metrics and escalate if thresholds hit.
oncall-maya: +1 and standing by. Will run `/deploy pause` if needed.
mlinfra-jin: +1 — image checksum OK, PDB tweak looks safe.
qa-rob: smoke OK: 50 sample calls, no 5xx, median 42ms, p95 90ms. +1.
ops-bot: deploy-bot started rollout: mlserv@3.2.1-hotfix-evict -> canary us-west1 5% at 3861234575
release-lead: Starting canary window now. Plan: monitor for 10m, ramp to 30% at +10m if stable. Call pause/rollback now if you see anomalies.
oncall-maya: Observed p95 jump to ~270ms at 3861234700, pausing rollout and initiating rollback of canary pods.
ops-bot: deploy-bot executed rollback: mlserv@3.2.1-hotfix-evict -> rolled back to mlserv@3.2.0 at 3861234712
sre-eli: Good catch; canary failure reproduced under probe load. We'll open a follow-up to debug eviction interactions with our autoscaler. Creating EVT ticket.
release-lead: Thanks all. Closing this expedited approval — hotfix rolled back. Follow-up actions: more load tests + config-only staging attempt before reattempt. Filing postmortem and timeline in #postmortems.
